context.transcript:
Megumi, I wanted to congratulate you on your successful presentation to the managers this morning.
We think the marketing strategy you presented is well suited to our new video streaming service.
Thank you.
The consultant we hired last month actually helped me quite a bit.
His market research showed exactly which age groups would be most interested in the movies and TV shows that we're going to offer.
I was especially interested in the data about spending and viewing patterns of consumers in their 30s.
We should make a special effort to target them.
That should increase our sales.
context.transcript_translation:
Megumi, 我想祝贺你今天早上向经理们做了一个成功的演示。
我们认为你展示的营销策略非常适合我们的新视频流媒体服务。
谢谢。
上个月聘请的顾问实际上帮了我很多。
他的市场调研准确地显示了哪些年龄组对我们将提供的电影和电视节目最感兴趣。
我对关于30岁左右消费者消费和观看模式的数据特别感兴趣。
我们应该努力将目标群体定为他们。
那应该能增加我们的销量。
